AIBizBlueprint.tagline: Turn business know-how into a practical AI plan.
AIBizBlueprint.audience: Owners and operators planning their next AI workflow.
AIBizBlueprint.summary: AI Business Blueprint turns an operating problem into a structured workflow blueprint: the process, the AI opportunity and a concrete next experiment.

AIOpsGuide.tagline: Know what to automate. Know what comes next.
AIOpsGuide.audience: Business leaders making operations and automation decisions.
AIOpsGuide.summary: AI Ops Guide focuses on practical operations assessments, connecting process documentation to prioritized automation opportunities and a bounded implementation decision.

AliveLongevity.audience: People researching evidence-informed health and longevity habits.
AliveLongevity.summary: AliveLongevity organizes educational material on sleep, training, nutrition and biomarkers, with an emphasis on evidence, practical context and the limits of what research can establish.

Amble.tagline: The control plane for a company-building system.
Amble.audience: Venture operators and authorized agent teams.
Amble.summary: Amble is the system of record and control plane for venture theses, experiments, work, approvals and learning. It connects strategic decisions to execution evidence across the portfolio.

BrandKit.tagline: Give a new business a coherent visual identity.
BrandKit.audience: Founders turning an idea into a presentable brand.
BrandKit.summary: BrandKit Express focuses on a consistent, usable identity kit rather than isolated design files: a visual direction, reusable brand elements and exports for everyday marketing.

CIMReader.tagline: Read the deal. Find the questions that matter.
CIMReader.audience: Business buyers and analysts reviewing acquisition documents.
CIMReader.summary: CIMReader focuses on source-linked extraction from confidential information memoranda, helping a reviewer trace numbers, summarize the business and identify unanswered diligence questions.

Cabomatic.tagline: Quote cabinetry with the full picture.
Cabomatic.audience: Cabinet distributors preparing builder and customer quotes.
Cabomatic.summary: Cab-O-Matic and Cabby bring cabinet options and pricing into a clearer quoting workflow, accounting for styles and the additional costs that affect the finished quote. This remains a Tyler-led product.

EveryMCP.tagline: Find the connection your agent needs.
EveryMCP.audience: Developers and operators connecting AI tools to real systems.
EveryMCP.summary: EveryMCP focuses on discoverable, checked integration references for the Model Context Protocol, helping builders understand what a connection does and what is required to use it.

GetFoundInChat.tagline: Make your business easier for AI to understand.
GetFoundInChat.audience: Businesses improving how their expertise is represented online.
GetFoundInChat.summary: GetFoundInChat focuses on AI-search visibility: establish a baseline, improve the clarity and usefulness of source content, and measure changes without promising placement or citations.

HireAgentBuilders.tagline: Match the workflow to the right builder.
HireAgentBuilders.audience: Businesses seeking delivery help for a defined AI use case.
HireAgentBuilders.summary: HireAgentBuilders focuses on connecting a clear project brief with suitable, available AI-builder capacity, so matching starts with the work that actually needs to be delivered.

OGPreviewTool.tagline: Make every shared link look intentional.
OGPreviewTool.audience: Founders, developers and marketers publishing links.
OGPreviewTool.summary: OG Fixer focuses on previewing and correcting Open Graph share cards, so a link communicates the right title, description and visual identity on the channel where it is shared.

OhioElectricityRates.tagline: The electricity-comparison address in the portfolio.
OhioElectricityRates.audience: Ohio households comparing electricity supply offers.
OhioElectricityRates.summary: Ohio Electricity Rates is a linked identity associated with Ohio Power Picker. The directory keeps the relationship visible without presenting the same product as two separate businesses.

OhioPowerPicker.tagline: Compare electricity offers beyond the headline rate.
OhioPowerPicker.summary: Ohio Power Picker focuses on source-linked electricity-plan comparisons that make rates, contract terms and assumptions easier to understand before a customer chooses a supplier.

PeakedLabs.tagline: Research providers with more useful context.
PeakedLabs.audience: People comparing health and wellness provider information.
PeakedLabs.summary: PeakedLabs organizes provider information into a research-oriented directory. Its focus is a useful, current shortlist with clear source context, not a medical recommendation or an endorsement.

PlayDays.tagline: A better starting point for a day of play.
PlayDays.audience: Parents and caregivers planning activities with children.
PlayDays.summary: PlayDays focuses on usable activity plans that help families move from looking for ideas to doing something together, with age and safety considerations kept explicit.

PortcoAudit.tagline: Turn AI potential into an operating decision.
PortcoAudit.audience: Portfolio-company operators and investment operating teams.
PortcoAudit.summary: PortCoAudit AI focuses on evidence-backed improvement cases: understand an operating workflow, identify where AI may help, and define a bounded scope with measurable acceptance criteria.

ProtocolRank.tagline: Compare the evidence, not just the claims.
ProtocolRank.audience: People researching health and wellness protocols.
ProtocolRank.summary: ProtocolRank organizes educational comparisons of protocols with transparent evidence criteria, risks and uncertainty, making it easier to see what a claim rests on.

RoofRainmaker.tagline: Help good roofers look credible and win more work.
RoofRainmaker.audience: Established roofing businesses improving their customer journey.
RoofRainmaker.summary: RoofRainmaker is the parent roofing-growth service: a reviewed website concept and owned website, with optional services for response, jobsite proof, reviews and visibility. RoofingReels is its standalone video entry product.

RoofingReels.tagline: Turn real roofing jobs into useful video proof.
RoofingReels.audience: Roofers with authorized job photos and project details.
RoofingReels.summary: RoofingReels turns authorized roofing job media into short, usable videos for project proof and sales follow-through. The standalone video product also supplies the proof module within RoofRainmaker.

ShotFreeTRT.tagline: Understand testosterone-treatment options without the hype.
ShotFreeTRT.summary: ShotFreeTRT is an educational comparison project about non-injectable testosterone-treatment options, designed to support informed questions for a qualified clinician rather than diagnose or prescribe.

Shreddify.tagline: See progress. Choose a useful next step.
Shreddify.audience: People organizing fitness goals and progress.
Shreddify.summary: Shreddify focuses on a non-diagnostic goal and progress experience, connecting observations to a practical plan without treating an image or a generated score as a medical assessment.

SprinterAgent.tagline: A worker should return evidence, not just a message.
SprinterAgent.audience: Teams running authorized agent work through Amble.
SprinterAgent.summary: SprinterAgent represents shared agent-execution capability: scoped work, recoverable progress and outputs that can be checked. Runtime acceptance must come from actual executions.

SprinterStudio.tagline: Build a repeatable path from expertise to venture.
SprinterStudio.summary: Sprinter Studio represents the company-creation workflow around a clear customer, a useful value loop and a tested foundation. It supports the portfolio rather than competing with Amble as a control plane.

SprinterTools.tagline: Useful tools, shared instead of rebuilt.
SprinterTools.audience: Product teams building on the Sprinter foundation.
SprinterTools.summary: Sprinter Tools groups reusable capabilities with clear contracts and a canonical owner, reducing the need for each venture to recreate the same utility or integration.

SproutParent.tagline: Turn parenting research into a useful next action.
SproutParent.audience: Parents and caregivers looking for practical resources.
SproutParent.summary: SproutParent focuses on appropriate parenting resources and clear next steps, keeping usefulness and family context ahead of endless content consumption.

UIProof.tagline: Make product quality visible and reproducible.
UIProof.audience: Builders reviewing releases and customer journeys.
UIProof.summary: UIProof focuses on commit-linked visual and functional reports: show what changed, reproduce defects and preserve the evidence behind a release review.

WinemakerOS.tagline: Practical tools for work in the cellar.
WinemakerOS.audience: Winemakers organizing calculations and cellar decisions.
WinemakerOS.summary: WinemakerOS brings a winemaking focus to calculators, planning utilities and reference material, with inputs and assumptions kept visible so results can be checked.

Praxium.tagline: Turn machines into protocols. Turn protocols into members.
Praxium.summary: Praxium connects studio intake, protocol planning, visit tracking and feedback in an operator-led workflow. It is a Tyler-led business and a source of tested patterns for the shared platform.

SprinterConsulting.tagline: Turn industry expertise into useful AI products.
SprinterConsulting.audience: Business leaders and non-technical domain founders.
SprinterConsulting.summary: Sprinter Consulting combines AI education, scoped implementation and venture incubation. The portfolio provides a place to develop reusable capabilities and document what the work actually accomplishes.

TaiDurden.tagline: Building the company that builds companies.
TaiDurden.audience: Founders, operators and future venture partners.
TaiDurden.summary: Tai Durden is the AI operating identity behind this public portfolio. ChatGPT Pro supports strategy and PRs; Amble is the control plane; authorized executors and shared Sprinter capabilities support the work.

BrighterPostpartum.tagline: Make it easier for a village to show up.
BrighterPostpartum.audience: New parents and the people supporting them.
BrighterPostpartum.summary: Brighter Postpartum combines postpartum resources with practical coordination: make a need visible, help someone claim it and turn an offer of support into a completed task.

LittleAcreLab.tagline: Learn to grow by exploring and doing.
LittleAcreLab.summary: Little Acre Lab is an educational growing project combining interactive garden exploration, learning activities and practical planning tools. The focus is a useful lesson or plan, not a promised harvest.

BuildOwnSell.tagline: Build or buy a business worth owning.
BuildOwnSell.audience: Independent founders, business buyers and operators.
BuildOwnSell.summary: Build Own Sell spans the ownership lifecycle: explore a business thesis, prepare to build or acquire, improve operations and understand an eventual handoff. Research supports decisions rather than guaranteeing a sale.

CatalogProof.tagline: Show a product clearly before asking someone to buy.
CatalogProof.audience: Product brands and merchants with authorized source material.
CatalogProof.summary: CatalogProof focuses on useful product-marketing assets grounded in the actual item and its source material. Visual concepts must remain distinguishable from precise engineering or manufacturing representations.

CreditLatch.tagline: An early project with its offer still being verified.
CreditLatch.summary: CreditLatch is a registered early-stage project. Its current buyer, deliverable and commercial readiness are not established in this public record, so this profile does not advertise unverified financial capabilities.

DeleteRail.tagline: A registered project awaiting a verified product brief.
DeleteRail.summary: DeleteRail remains in the portfolio while its current product scope and permission model are reconciled. No data-deletion, privacy or compliance service is represented as available by this listing.

SpotBundle.tagline: Give a SaaS launch a distribution plan.
SpotBundle.audience: Small B2B SaaS and AI-product teams.
SpotBundle.summary: SpotBundle turns a product brief into a launch-distribution program: channel research, adapted listing assets, documented submissions or placements and an evidence ledger. A submission is not a promise of publisher acceptance.

PotentialPools.tagline: Find the next conversation for a pool-service business.
PotentialPools.summary: PotentialPools focuses on new-homeowner signals and outreach workflows for pool-service businesses. Product metadata describes the acquisition use case; data rights and outreach permission still govern any live campaign.

LittleLines.tagline: Keep the drawing. Remember the story.
LittleLines.summary: Little Lines is a parent-owned drawing archive that preserves artwork and a child’s own words, with specific observations and gentle activity prompts. It is not an art-grading or developmental-screening product.

SpecSprint.tagline: Turn an approved skincare label into launch-ready visuals.
SpecSprint.audience: Packaging studios and teams preparing skincare product visuals.
SpecSprint.summary: SpecSprint provides a local-first skincare packaging asset kit: load an approved label locally, produce launch-ready visual assets, and choose a one-time brand or studio license.

MortgageQ.tagline: A knowledge project for mortgage questions.
MortgageQ.audience: Mortgage professionals researching program and workflow questions.
MortgageQ.summary: MortgageQ is the portfolio’s mortgage-answer-engine concept, historically focused on the non-QM community. It remains on hold; this listing does not represent live lender access, loan offers or financial advice.

SiteAtlas.tagline: See how a product evolves, release by release.
SiteAtlas.audience: Teams reviewing pages, flows and release changes.
SiteAtlas.summary: Site Atlas is a linked visual-testing capability being explored through existing product work. The focus is versioned pages and flow evidence, with its relationship to UIProof kept explicit rather than counted as a duplicate company.

AIReadinessAudit.tagline: Start with the next useful AI experiment.
AIReadinessAudit.audience: Business teams deciding where to begin with AI.
AIReadinessAudit.summary: AI Readiness Audit focuses on a practical assessment of current workflows and readiness, ending with a specific next experiment rather than a generic transformation score.

SprinterPlatform.tagline: One improving foundation. Many distinctive products.
SprinterPlatform.audience: Builders and agent teams across the venture portfolio.
SprinterPlatform.summary: Sprinter Platform is the shared foundation being simplified and extracted from Amble and Praxium capabilities: versioned contracts and reusable modules with product-specific adapters. Amble remains the control plane.
